batch.description: One workflow over many inputs: rows from CSV, Excel (XLSX) or JSON, with limits for cost and failures.
batch.intro: Upload a table, map its columns to the input form and check the cost before anything starts.
batch.name: Name (optional)
batch.fileHint: CSV (comma or semicolon), XLSX or JSON (a list of objects), at most 1000 rows and 10 MB.
batch.emptyText: A batch run handles many inputs of the same kind at once, e.g. 200 customer requests.

benchmark.description: Fixed test cases for a workflow: rules check the results, optionally an AI rates them. This is how you compare versions.
benchmark.emptyText: Create test cases with inputs and expected properties, and check after every change whether the workflow got better or worse.
benchmark.judgeCriteriaHint: One criterion per line. Empty: no AI rating for this case.
benchmark.expectedHint: An example of a good result; the AI rating compares with it.
benchmark.judgeModelHint: Rates only cases with criteria; its cost is counted separately.
benchmark.pick: Pick the test run of {{date}} for the comparison
benchmark.versionHint: This is how you test an older version against the current one.
benchmark.judgeHint: An AI rates cases with criteria. Its verdict is marked as an AI rating and costs extra.
benchmark.judgedCases_one: {{count}} case is rated by the AI.
benchmark.judgedCases_other: {{count}} cases are rated by the AI.
benchmark.caseProblem: {{name}}: {{errors}}. This case is skipped as invalid.
benchmark.aiNote: verdict of an AI ({{model}}), not a check rule

schedule.description: Starts workflows regularly while Nodestro runs. Every schedule is off until you switch it on.
schedule.intro: When and with what the workflow starts. Switching it on checks everything (budget, inputs, tools).
schedule.dayOfMonthHint: In shorter months: the last day.
schedule.offUntilEnabled: After saving, a new schedule stays off until you switch it on in the list.
schedule.savedOff: Saved. The check failed, so the schedule is now off.
schedule.emptyText: A schedule starts a workflow e.g. every Monday at 8 am with fixed inputs.
